policyFacts.institutionSubsetRule: At least12 of30 UMPI credits must be in the major, including9 upper-level credits among those12. The exact minor-based BLS application needs the governing catalog.
policyFacts.transferScope: No fixed incoming-transfer limit is published in the current FAQ. Ninety outside credits is the arithmetic remainder within120 after30 UMPI residency; it is not a separately verified ACE cap.

policyReview.text: The2025–26handbook pp8–9 lists ACE under CPL, then states a combined bachelor CPL maximum of30. It also says up to90 outside credits may apply. The current FAQ gives no incoming limit and requires30 UMPI credits but does not resolve how the older30-CPL statement applies to evaluated ACE coursework. The governing2026–27catalog must resolve that scope before a90-ACE plan is asserted.
